description: Aggregate a company's GTM signals into one composite score. Runs hiring and tech-stack detection by default, plus funding, events, or workplace when named in sources, in one call and returns a composite score, recommended action, and optional summary as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

explain_mode.description: If true, the summary becomes a longer, more detailed explanation.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

sources.description: Which signals to aggregate. Defaults to hiring and tech_stack. Each extra source adds one sub actor run to the bill and one dimension to the composite score, which is normalized over the sources selected.

name: aggregate_gtm_signals
title: Aggregate GTM Signals
